plainSummary: The plan now separates publishing proof from credential setup and preserves safe retries during identity migration.
summary: Re-reviewed F-1 and F-2 against updated W-015. AC-4 now cites the relevant release-only SL-014 and explicitly requires separate organization-secret availability/authenticated dry-run observations, never inferred from workflow tests. Stable request IDs remain correlation keys while entity identities are generated. The plan also requires explicit reconciliation of divergent ancestor edits and a frozen per-origin mapping reused after interruption. These changes resolve the reviewed gaps without changing user-authorized scope.
residualRisks: A passing release-workflow claim alone does not prove organization credential setup; retain explicit operational evidence or clearly report the credential outcome as outstanding.
Identity migration must preserve original artifact hashes and historical source provenance; current tests and screenshot coverage establish fresh proof rather than restamped historical success.
The related pack exposes only generic worktree caution text, so integration must independently validate the two explicitly chosen origin histories.
